resources.string: Local AI engine. Runs LLM models on ARM64 without internet.
Workflow automation. Native (udocker) or proot Debian, your choice. Port :5678.
Native Python 3.13 with pip and built-in SQLite.
Anthropic\'s AI-powered code editor. Native ARM64 version.
OpenAI\'s terminal code assistant. Normal or VL (code-mode) variant.
Local AI gateway compatible with Claude. Native glibc version.
AI-powered code editor via web. Supports local Ollama.
AI agent with gateway for Telegram, Discord, and SMS.
Build React Native apps with EAS CLI.
Persistent memory for AI agents. Built from source in Go.
Free coding agent from CodebuffAI (Deepseek, MiMo, GLM, Minimax). No account or API key needed.
Multi-model coding agent from CodebuffAI, works with any OpenRouter model (installs via npm - CodebuffAI doesn\'t publish a standalone native binary for this product).
Official GitHub Copilot CLI. Requires an active Copilot account.
Official MiniMax CLI - text, image, video, voice, music, and search from the terminal.
Xiaomi\'s coding agent, persistent memory across sessions (experimental - no official Android build on npm).
Mistral AI\'s official terminal coding agent.
Alibaba\'s code CLI (fork of Gemini CLI) powered by the Qwen3-Coder model.

Basic level: nmap + netcat + dirb + nikto + theHarvester + sqlmap + MVT + ClamAV (native). Pro level: also a full Kali Linux container (proot-distro), with or without a graphical interface. For your own network or with authorization.
~2 min (basic) / up to ~30 min (pro: Kali container + GUI, depending on network)
Native XFCE4 desktop ready to install (no distro needed) - or a full Linux distro (proot) if you need one.
MySQL/MariaDB + PostgreSQL + SQLite + Redis - full servers and SQLite database management.

Catalog of ready-to-use dev stacks: Python+PostgreSQL, PHP+MySQL, React+Vite (TypeScript/JavaScript), vanilla HTML/CSS/JS (native in Termux, like a small VPS) or a full Linux distro (Debian/Ubuntu via proot). Reuses the Python/Database modules and adds Node.js/PHP.

Rootless containers (Docker Hub and compatible) via PRoot - the same engine n8n already uses internally, exposed here as a general tool with pull/run/list/rm. Not real Docker (no kernel namespaces/cgroups); see the Docker module.

qemu-user (run binaries from another architecture, e.g. x86_64 on ARM64, real use without root) + headless qemu-system WITHOUT KVM acceleration (Android doesn\'t expose /dev/kvm without root) - pure software, slow; doesn\'t include any OS image.

Real Docker (dockerd) is NOT possible without root on Android/Termux - the kernel doesn\'t expose namespaces/cgroups to unprivileged apps (a system limitation, not a Termux one). This module doesn\'t fake-install anything: it explains why and points to the udocker module, the real alternative already available in Kairos.
Local AI engine - llama.cpp HTTP server (OpenAI-compatible) + embedded engine for the chat. Uses the AI Chat\'s .gguf files and serves OpenCode/Hermes/OpenClaw.
Local tool-calling engine (45M params, ~28MB RAM). Runs tasks and bash/python/json scripts with AI (reasoning via Ollama/llama-server) or without AI (direct mode).
IDE right inside Termux: Neovim + NvChad + GitHub Copilot + CodeCompanion. Opens with nvim from the terminal.

Compiles Android projects on the device (no Android Studio): aapt2 + javac + kotlinc + d8 + zipalign + apksigner. Supports Java and Kotlin (pure JVM) - does NOT compile React Native/JS or native C/C++ via CMake/NDK. Compile from Download, its subfolders, or ~/proyectos.
Moonshot AI\'s official code CLI (Kimi). Requires Node.js 22.19+.
Code CLI (fork of the OpenCode engine) with its own provider ecosystem.
Cursor\'s terminal coding agent (official binary with embedded Node, glibc layer).
Manage Hugging Face models, datasets, and spaces from the terminal (hf download with resume, hf upload).
Live-checks that installed modules keep working (6 strategies: cmd, pkg, dir, file, plugin, config).
Packages installed modules into real .deb files and builds a local apt repo (Packages/Release + checksums). Robust module install/update: dpkg-deb or ar as fallback.
Perl interpreter - a dependency for some tools (e.g. PSQL Format).
Rust (rustc + cargo) native, precompiled for ARM64.
Official GitHub CLI (gh) - repos, PRs, issues from the terminal.
TypeScript (tsc) - installs Node.js first if missing.
NestJS CLI (the `nest` command) - installs Node.js first if missing.
Prettier code formatter - installs Node.js first if missing.
Static server with auto-reload (`live-server`) - installs Node.js first if missing.
HTTP tunnels via Localtunnel (`lt`), with a URL-opening fix for Android - installs Node.js first if missing.
Vercel CLI for deploys - installs Node.js first if missing.
Live Markdown server - installs Node.js first if missing.
SQL formatter (`psqlformat`, requires Perl) - installs Node.js first if missing.
Checks/updates package.json versions (`ncu`) - installs Node.js first if missing.
HTTP tunnels via Ngrok (npm variant) - installs Node.js first if missing.
Install/manage Termux\'s native programming languages (Node.js, Perl, PHP, Rust, C/C++, Go) - one switch per language, with real detected version.
npm dev tools ready to toggle on/off (TypeScript, NestJS CLI, Prettier, Live Server, Localtunnel, Vercel CLI, Markserv, PSQL Format, NPM Check Updates, Ngrok) - one switch per tool.
Terminal coding agent (earendil-works/pi, npm). Command: pi. No confirmed flags/login of its own - installs via npm with Node.js/ripgrep/git/fd.
Static code analysis: builds a relationship graph of a project\'s files/functions/classes/modules (colbymchenry/codegraph). NOT an AI agent - a navigation/refactor tool.

Improved/standalone version of Pi Coding Agent (can1357/oh-my-pi) - glibc binary with Rust addons (AST grep, diff, fuzzy find, shell exec), sessions, and MCP. Command: omp. Installs via native glibc (recommended by the project).
